messages:
ana: Quick heads-up: hetero-gpu-scheduler + adaptive-fallback-routing landed in canary and the numbers look solid. rolling to 40% now. :rocket:

ana: TL;DR (prod-weighted):
```text
Before: p50=33ms, p95=140ms, p99=410ms, cost/token=$0.00178
After:  p50=32ms, p95=105ms, p99=320ms, cost/token=$0.00121
Net: p99 -22%, cost/token -32%
Hot(<512): p99 -19% 
VeryLong(>8k): p99 -16%, fallback-rate -45%
```

li: awesome. any changes to client-visible behavior? fallbacks used to be per-request; are we changing selection semantics?

ana: no change to request semantics. adaptive-fallback-routing only changes which replica gets the request based on GPU health and queue depth; we still honor model version pins and strict-fallback flags. will add a note to the API docs.

pete: did we see any spike in retries or decoding errors during the 6h canary?

ana: error-rate stable. retries down slightly (likely from fewer overloaded replicas). decoding diffs none on daily regression set. we did notice a tiny increase in end-to-end latency variance for a small subset (0.1% of requests) tied to cross-region routing decisions; investigating but not impacting p99 gates.

support: can we get a short blurb for customers on dedicated/private? some accounts care about strict replica membership.

ana: will draft a short note: "Runtime: improved tail latency and unit costs via heterogeneous GPU scheduler and adaptive fallback routing; no changes to model API or deterministic behavior. Dedicated customers can opt-out via runtime flag."

li: rollout plan & guardrails?

ana: plan: 0->canary(2%) -> 2% -> 10% -> 40% (now) -> 100% if stable. gate thresholds: p99 regression >3% OR error-rate +0.4% absolute => rollback. rollback = feature-flag flip in infra console; infra runbook updated. oncall channel subscribed.
deploy-bot: Deployment event: commit=c4d9b71 promoted to 40% on prod. Monitoring: perf-gates OK, error-rate OK. link: https://redwood.internal/deploys/c4d9b71

pete: can we capture per-region and per-seqlen p99 curves for the modeling team? need bins: 0-256,256-1k,1k-4k,4k-12k. also export fallback-rate and replica-switch-rate.

ana: will attach the bench CSV and Grafana snapshots to the PR and runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hetero-fallback-rollout. pinging @li for the docs change.

li: also add a customer opt-out flag name and RBAC requirements in the runbook so Customer Success can toggle for sensitive tenants.

ana: good call. adding: `runtime.no_adaptive_fallback=true` + docs on RBAC. will also DM support the rollout note.

support: thanks. we'll prepare outreach for a couple enterprise tenants with strict SLAs and confirm flags.

ana: thanks team! holding at 40% for 45m and reconvene after metrics. big thanks to infra + scheduler teams. :tada:

(automated) metrics captured: p50/p95/p99, cost/token, fallback-rate, replica-switch-rate, gpu-util, error-rate. runbook thresholds defined at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hetero-fallback-rollout.
